trial_court: Special Judge SC/ST Act, Dhanbad, Cr. Appeal (SJ) No.496 of 2024
case_name: Bipin Paswan Aged About 44 Years vs The State Of Jharkhand

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Bipin Paswan aged about 44 years, son of Shri Baleshwar Dusadh, resident of Prem Nagar (Near Hanuman Mandir), Putki, P.O. Kusunda, P.S. Putki, Town Dhanbad, District - Dhanbad
parties.respondent_defendant: 1. The State of Jharkhand, 2. Jai Ram Kumar Singh

facts_of_case: Complaint filed by the complainant was dismissed. Appellant's cheques were lost and misused by respondent No.2. Appellant lodged FIR for loss of cheques.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the complainant to prove that the cheque was dishonoured due to the drawer's default.
legal_principles.held: While as a matter of fact, the cheques of the appellant were lost and it has been misused by the Respondent No. 2 by filing a cheque bounce case against the appellant.

legal_principles.principle: A complainant cannot file a false case and then claim that the cheque was dishonoured due to the drawer's default.
legal_principles.held: It has further been submitted that this appellant has lodged an FIR for the loss of the cheques from the very next date and the bank was also duly informed by which the payment through those cheques have been withheld on the basis of the request of a stop payment by the Appellant.

outcome.final_order: This appeal is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to raise all the points before the concerned cheque bounce case.
